summary: Frontend-only regression verification passed for the Kuppam factory gallery on desktop and mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: Reviewed gallery implementation, responsive CSS, lightbox state, and product filter wiring; no critical issues observed.
Contact actions remain intentional placeholders because official business details were not provided.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified four gallery tiles, featured Kuppam image, desktop navigation, lightbox open/close, Amogh product filtering, mobile menu navigation, mobile lightbox, and no horizontal overflow. The browser script's final generic error scan had a malformed JavaScript selector, which is a test-script issue only; it did not indicate an app error.
